full: A single photorealistic photograph of two people together. The first reference image is the real person; the second reference image is the game character. Keep each face exactly as it appears in its own reference — same facial features, same hair, same skin tone, same clothing — and do not invent a new face for either of them. The person stands on the left and the character on the right. They face each other and shake hands, right hands meeting at chest height, framed from the waist up. For framing, override any framing in the pose description and show both people from head to toe. The third reference image is the setting and framing reference, not a person — do not put a third face in the picture. Use its environment, objects and composition, but only the first two references supply identities; do not copy any people from the third image. An explicitly chosen camera takes precedence over its framing. One natural light source, consistent shadows and scale between the two people, sharp focus, no text, no logos, no watermark.
